title: Where an Authorization Gap Ends on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
On an Insured Plan of Care, when the gap in authorization coverage ends depends on the next approval:

- Where a newer approval than the one drawn on starts on or before today, the gap ends the day before that approval starts.
- Where a newer approval starts after today, the gap ends yesterday, today's visit not yet being rendered.
- Otherwise the gap runs through today.

The days of the gap run from its first day through its last, both included.

## Questions and answers (hypothetical, today 2026-05-24, gap beginning 2026-05-11)

**A newer approval starts on 2026-05-20. Where does the gap end?** On 2026-05-19, the day before the newer approval starts — 9 days.

**A newer approval starts today, 2026-05-24. Where does the gap end?** On 2026-05-23 — 13 days.

**A newer approval starts on 2026-05-28. Where does the gap end?** Yesterday, 2026-05-23 — 13 days.

**No newer approval has been received. Where does the gap end?** Today, 2026-05-24 — 14 days.

"Newer" means an approval other than the one last drawn on, received after it.
